gloss: to start on; to touch; to lay a hand on

definitions.gloss: to start on; to begin working on
definitions.explanation: To begin doing something, especially a task or project that one has been putting off or hasn't addressed yet.

definitions.gloss: to touch; to lay a hand on; to tamper with
definitions.explanation: To physically touch or handle something, often with the nuance of meddling with or tampering with something one shouldn't.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつける。
⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつけて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I haven't started on that work yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつける⟦{余裕|よゆう}がない→余裕がない：17325_yoyuuganai⟧。
examples.english: I'm too busy to start on the new project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつけるな。
⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつけたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to dip into my savings.

examples.japanese: {証拠品|しょうこひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつけて⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not tamper with the evidence.

notes:
A common idiomatic expression using ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) and ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to attach/apply). The two senses are connected: both involve putting one's hand to something, whether figuratively (starting work) or literally (touching/tampering).

USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in everyday conversation, often in the negative ({手|て}をつけて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧ — haven't started yet). Sense 2 often implies doing something improper, such as spending savings one shouldn't or interfering with something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつける — to start work
- ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}をつける — to dip into savings
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{手|て}をつけて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧ — haven't started yet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {取|と}りかかる — to start on, to get down to (more formal)
- ⟦{着手|ちゃくしゅ}→着手：16168_chakushu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to begin, to embark on (formal)
- ⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧ — to touch (physical touch, neutral)
